text:
Mara K: Quick idea — can we pilot an 'Action Journal' for PM/postmortem follow-ups?
Short, single doc per incident that tracks: owner, due date, status, recurrence flag, link to postmortem, and IC rotation notes.
Run it for 8 weeks, with a weekly 15-min pulse check for remediation progress. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jordan L: I like it. Keeps things lightweight. Can we auto-create entries from the postmortem template so owners don't have to retype?

Samir: +1. Draft template below — can auto-open as a Github issue or a Google Doc from the postmortem closure step.

Samir: ```
Action Journal entry:
- Incident ID: 
- Postmortem link: 
- Owner: @
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Status: open/in-progress/blocked/closed
- Recurrence flag: none/recurring/suspected pattern
- Root cause summary (1 line): 
- Mitigation tasks: [task 1] [task 2]
- IC notes: rotation suggestions, handoff items
- Follow-up check dates: weekly dates (auto-schedule)
```

Khalid: Prefer making them Github issues in a dedicated repo so we get assignees, labels, PR-linked fixes, and automatic reminders. Sheets are fine for quick pilots but issues scale better. Also add a label for "recurring-pattern".

ops-bot: reminder: New incident action journal template created in #eng-oncall (link: https://go.redwood.example/action-journal-template) :bell:

Rowan: For IC rotation: propose a simple rotation calendar we update monthly. When an incident closes, the journal should include whether the next incident IC should be the same person or rotate (flag: keep/rotate). That helps avoid tacit knowledge bottlenecks.

Elena: Comms cadence proposal:
- T+0: initial incident post in #incidents + triage summary in #eng-oncall
- T+1h: public update (short status)
- T+24h: incident summary + link to action journal (owners/due dates)
- T+72h: first remediation progress update
- Weekly: pulse check until all actions closed or downgraded

Mara K: Nice, Elena. Let's make the T+24h message include a table of owners/due dates and recurrence flag so product/support can triage resource needs.

Jordan L: Volunteers for the pilot: I'll set up the Github repo and a tiny GH Actions workflow to auto-create issues from the postmortem close step. Also add a bot to ping owners 48h before due date.

Samir: I'll own the journal template and the weekly pulse checklist doc.

Khalid: I'll add labels and a simple dashboard for recurring-pattern incidents (heatmap + top 5 recurring routes).

Rowan: I'll update the IC rotation calendar and put the monthly sign-up sheet in the handbook.

Mara K: Thanks all — can we aim to run the pilot starting next Monday for 8 weeks? If no objections, I'll send a short kickoff note and the acceptance criteria (owners assigned within 48h, >80% of actions with due dates, weekly pulse meetings scheduled).

Jordan L: Sounds good from me.

Samir: Good to go.

Khalid: 👍

Elena: :+1:

Mara K: Cool — I'll post kickoff + link to the template tomorrow. If anyone else wants in on the pilot, ping me.
